import sys; sys.path.insert(0,str(WORK))
code=r'''
import numpy as np
from poolfit import *
def pool_logits(M, C, W):
    P='bert.encoder.layer.11.'
    Wo=W(P+'attention.output.dense.weight').astype(np.float64); bo=W(P+'attention.output.dense.bias').astype(np.float64)
    Wv=W(P+'attention.self.value.weight').astype(np.float64); bv=W(P+'attention.self.value.bias').astype(np.float64)
    g1=W(P+'attention.output.LayerNorm.weight').astype(np.float64); be1=W(P+'attention.output.LayerNorm.bias').astype(np.float64)
    W1=W(P+'intermediate.dense.weight').astype(np.float64)[:1024]; b1=W(P+'intermediate.dense.bias').astype(np.float64)[:1024]
    W2=W(P+'output.dense.weight').astype(np.float64)[:, :1024]; b2=W(P+'output.dense.bias').astype(np.float64)
    g2=W(P+'output.LayerNorm.weight').astype(np.float64); be2=W(P+'output.LayerNorm.bias').astype(np.float64)
    pw=W('bert.pooler.dense.weight').astype(np.float64); pb=W('bert.pooler.dense.bias').astype(np.float64)
    cw=W('classifier.weight').astype(np.float64); cb=W('classifier.bias').astype(np.float64)
    ctx=M@Wv.T+bv
    z=LN(ctx@Wo.T+bo+C)*g1+be1
    h=LN(z+gelu(z@W1.T+b1)@W2.T+b2)*g2+be2
    return np.tanh(h@pw.T+pb)@cw.T+cb
'''
open('lib10.py','w').write(code)
import numpy as np, json
from lib10 import *
from lib7 import labels_for
d=np.load('final_design.npz'); Mn,Cn,Sdep=d['Mn'],d['Cn'],d['Sdep']
allids=[r['id'] for r in practice()]; y=labels_for(allids, practice, LABELS)
lg=pool_logits(Mn,Cn,W)
print('pred acc', (lg.argmax(1)==y).mean(), 'agree with Sdep', (lg.argmax(1)==Sdep.argmax(1)).mean())
print('logit range', lg.min().round(3), lg.max().round(3), 'max |tanh arg| proxy', np.abs(np.arctanh(np.clip(lg,-0.999999,0.999999))).max().round(3))
srt=np.sort(lg,1); print('min margin', (srt[:,-1]-srt[:,-2]).min().round(4))
# check proportionality of logit-arg with Sdep centered
A=np.arctanh(lg); Ac=A-A.mean(1,keepdims=True); Sc=Sdep-Sdep.mean(1,keepdims=True)
k=(Ac*Sc).sum(1)/(Sc**2).sum(1); print('per-sample scale mean/cv', k.mean().round(4), (k.std()/k.mean()).round(4), 'resid', np.abs(Ac-k[:,None]*Sc).max())
np.save('pred_logits_final.npy', lg)
